Connect Ricing Town Helper

Run npm run helper in the project folder, then enter the six-digit code printed in the terminal. The secret remains in this browser session and is never saved in the project.

Export configuration

Compatibility Inspector

Native elements export to Waybar. Free-positioned and custom elements remain in Quickshell. Approximations are listed before download.

Asset Manager

Import a local icon or cursor theme folder. Files are checked, hashed and stored in the project; add its license and source before sharing.

Import Waybar

Select a JSON/JSONC configuration. CSS is optional. Commands and scripts are retained only as disabled metadata and are never executed.

Widget Neighborhood

Create a widget visually, then edit its text, data source, shape, animation, colors and children in the Properties panel. Live exports use available system data and show unavailable values honestly.

Complete desktop starters

Opening a starter keeps the current project as the recovery copy.
